messages:
maya: Quick heads-up — ran a compact A100 vs H100 regional sweep for three 7B models (llama-2-7b-chat, mistral-7b, starcoder-7b). Captured prefill + decode latencies, tokens/sec, and extrapolated $/1M tokens. Posting top-line numbers.
liam: Awesome — did you keep kernel/quant settings consistent?
maya: Yep — baseline is q8x4 decode, no KV cache warmups, batch=1 steady-state, and the runtime picked the best kernel per GPU. Regions: us-west, eu-west, asia-northeast.
sophia: Curious about p95 tails — regional network effects?
maya: Added a p95 delta row. Asia shows ~8-12% p95 bump vs us for decode due to our network hop counts on the private cluster.
perf-bot: CSV attached (inline).

liam: Nice. H100 consistently ~1.3-1.5x tokens/sec uplift and lower $/1M despite higher hw cost — thanks to kernel wins.
sophia: Did you try int8 or fallback kernels?
maya: Quick spot-check: int8 gave slightly better throughput on A100 for starcoder but degraded quality in our eval set. H100 kernels made q8x4 more stable.
ops-oncall: Any operational notes for Dedicated capacity sizing?
maya: Based on tokens/sec target 5k qps (avg request ~40 tokens), for llama-2-7b-chat: H100 pool ~ (5k * 40) / 545 ~= 367 concurrent tokens/sec capacity => need ~9 H100 instances (accounting for safety/burst + 20%). For A100 it's ~12.
liam: Suggest we publish a short note in the infra runbook with the CSV and the sizing calc. Also add a flag for region fallback to avoid asia p95 surprises.
sophia: I'll add a quick eval patch to check generation-quality delta for q8x4 vs int8 on a 200-sample prompt set.
maya: Filed follow-ups: #1 publish CSV + sizing math; #2 run q-sensitivity eval; #3 kernel selection trace capture for one H100 run. Will ping when done. :thumbsup:
liam: Thanks — this helps prioritize Dedicated SKU offers for EU customers.
perf-bot: benchmark-summary: 3 models, 3 regions, 2 GPUs — saved to /bench/quick-sweeps/1756004321.csv
ops-oncall: copying results into capacity planning sheet now.
